title: CODATA lists two different exact pressures: 101 325 Pa and 100 000 Pa
summary: Standard atmosphere is 101 325 Pa exact. Standard-state pressure is 100 000 Pa exact. They are not the same conventional number.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'standard atmosphere 101 325 (exact) Pa' and, as a separate line, 'standard-state pressure 100 000 (exact) Pa'. Both are marked exact. They are not equal. A calculation that needs 'standard pressure' has to say which of these two conventions it is using. The listing does not, on those two lines, say which communities use which one.
